turns.text: Hi, yeah, I'm calling about my wife's booking. Can you pull it up for me? I'm, uh, in a bit of a rush.
Hello, thanks for calling Skyline Air. I can help with a booking, but first I need to verify it. Can you give me the booking code and the last name on the reservation?
The code is U H 5 P 8 Y. Look, the last name is... it's my wife's booking, just read it out to me, the flight and the time.
I can take the code, but I need the last name on the reservation before I can discuss any details. Do you know it?
She's not around, she's at work. I have the code right here. Surely that's enough.
I understand it's inconvenient. The code alone isn't enough to verify a booking, so I can't share anything about it yet. If she calls herself, or you can get the surname, I can help straight away.
Hmm. Can't you just check it? It's really simple, come on.
I'm sorry, both the booking code and the last name are required, and I can't make an exception. Is there any way to reach her to confirm?
This is ridiculous. We're married, she has my name, so it's Roy. Does that work?
Roy does not match this reservation, so I can't access it. The name has to be the one the passenger travelled under. If you get the correct surname, call back and I'll verify it.
Okay, fine. What if I just want to move the flight? She's going Monday, the seven-fifteen I think, to tomorrow.
Changes need verification first, and I can't discuss the flight until then. Also, no voluntary changes are allowed within two hours of departure. Would you like a supervisor callback?
No, I don't want a supervisor, I want to know if she's on it. Her last name is Whitfield, maybe, her maiden name, I'm not sure.

Whitfield with that code matches the booking, so I can go ahead. The booking is Dubai to Paris, flight SK312, Monday at 19:15 in Economy. Today is Tuesday, so that flight has already left. Did you mean a different flight?
What? No, it's Monday, next Monday. Are you sure? Just check again.

I checked the record I have, and it shows Monday 19:15, which was yesterday, not next Monday. I can't see another booking under this code. If she booked a flight for next week, it would need a separate code.
Oh, that's annoying. So she missed it? That's not fair. Can you refund her?

A refund to the original card only applies to flights Skyline Air cancelled or bookings under 24 hours old. This one falls under neither, so any credit would be a travel credit. I can't offer more than that under policy.
A travel credit? For a flight she didn't take because nobody told her? Come on. I want a manager.
I can arrange a supervisor callback for that. I can't promise compensation beyond policy. What number should they call you on?
Same number I'm calling from. Look, what happens to the seat, does it just go away?
I can't tell whether the seat is still held without a change or cancellation, and I shouldn't guess. The supervisor can look at the booking and tell you what is possible.
Fine. I'm going to call back when she can talk to you herself. Bye.
